Strategy, Architecture, and Governance
1. Governance, scope and decision rights
Statutory accountability and portfolio governance
The NDIA must assign clear decision rights and accountable roles for technology portfolio planning so statutory, security and procurement obligations are met.
NDIA must govern its ICT technology portfolio through approved forums with clear scope, delegated decision rights, named owners and documented decisions.
Mandatory policy control
Critical

2. Portfolio planning cycle and capability roadmaps
Annual planning, capability alignment and roadmaps
The NDIA must plan its ICT portfolio on a regular cycle aligned to business capabilities, security planning, annual performance and digital investment plans.
NDIA must run an annual technology portfolio planning cycle and keep capability roadmaps that show current state, target state, dependencies, funding needs and security risks.
